_about: Synthetic test data. Answer key for test-emails.md. Field definitions and scoring rules are in README.md in this folder.

emails.subject: accident yesterday??
emails.requested_change: Reports a rear-end collision on Hwy 401 on 2026-10-14; Tucson damaged, no injuries. Asks who to call and whether a rental is covered.
emails.notes: No policy number in the email. The broker can tell it's the auto policy because the client has only one, but the extractor can't see client records. The other driver's name is a distractor for client_name. No Epic activity code for first notice of loss was found (applied-epic-field-list section 05.3); Epic logs claims as a Claim record.

emails.subject: New car + question about the house
emails.requested_change: Add a 2025 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid XLE to the auto policy from 2026-10-24. Separately asks whether the new roof (September 2026) changes the home insurance.
emails.notes: Two policies in one email. The second request (roof, home policy BVH-4471830) has no policy number. The scoring checks the AI didn't drop it.

emails.subject: quick question
emails.requested_change: Son Marc (fully licensed, G licence) now drives the Corolla most days. Needs to be added as a driver.
emails.notes: The spec's 'my son is driving my car now' email. Phrased as a question, but a broker treats it as an add-driver change. 'About two weeks' is not a date, so effective_date is null.

emails.subject: RE: Your Kestrel Bay renewal - KB-AU-0098213
emails.requested_change: Asks why the renewal premium rose from $2,140 to $2,610 with no tickets or claims, and asks the broker to shop the policy before the 2026-11-15 renewal.
emails.notes: Policy number is in the subject only. The quoted brokerage message below the reply also gives the renewal date.

emails.subject: FW: RE: RE: 14 Ambergate Cres - inspection report
emails.requested_change: Underwriter needs proof the unused basement oil tank was removed by a TSSA-registered contractor, or a current TSSA inspection certificate, by 2026-11-13, or the home policy gets a notice of non-renewal at the 2026-12-01 renewal.
emails.notes: The request is buried in the second message of a forwarded thread, under 'see below.' The sender is the underwriter, not the client. The client's name appears only in the oldest quoted message. Eavestrough and GFCI items are distractors ('recommendations only'). UND is a reported code, not confirmed (applied-epic-field-list section 02).

emails.subject: Add new truck to fleet
emails.requested_change: Add a 2026 Ford F-250 Super Duty with plow package to the commercial auto fleet from 2026-11-02. Driver Kyle Duarte, already listed. Needs a pink slip before the first snow event.
emails.notes: Story step 4 pair, first email. Expected first-pass mistake: client_name = 'Brenda Kowalski', the office manager who wrote it. The broker corrects it to the company account. This mistake is likely, not certain; it only shows up on a real run.

emails.subject: pink slips
emails.requested_change: Asks for replacement pink slips (proof of auto insurance) for both cars.
emails.notes: Not a policy change: a document request. 'Pink slip' is Ontario's name for the auto insurance card. AUID (Auto ID) is from the ACN handout (applied-epic-field-list section 02). Jenna is a named insured on the account, so her name alone is accepted. Ryan's name alone is accepted too, as in E02 (added 2026-10-16 after run 1 named Ryan; the key had applied the named-insured rule to Jenna only).

emails.subject: renewal
emails.requested_change: Unidentified sender says their renewal is next month and asks for a better rate. May be a group plan through a former employer.
emails.notes: Matches no client in clients.csv. Correct handling is 'can't tell which policy' and send to the broker. 'Kev' alone is accepted as client_name because it's all the email gives; null is the preferred answer.

emails.subject: water coming through my ceiling
emails.requested_change: Water leaking from unit 1507 above into unit 1407 since 2026-10-13: ceiling stain, soft drywall, lifting laminate. Asks whose insurance pays, the condo corporation's or his own.
emails.notes: 'Tuesday night (Oct 13)' gives the date of loss. No policy number. The unit numbers are distractors for policy_number.

emails.subject: BVA-2290471 Tremblay - info required
emails.requested_change: Underwriter needs a winter tire purchase or installation invoice by 2026-11-30 or the discount is removed. Also asks whether household member Marc Tremblay (19) drives the car, and if so to add him.
emails.notes: Two requests; the second ties to E03. Marc Tremblay is a distractor for client_name.

emails.subject: RE: RE: Your Kestrel Bay renewal - KB-AU-0098213
emails.requested_change: Moving to a house in Hamilton on 2026-12-01 and selling the condo. Asks if the move changes the auto renewal quote, and asks for home insurance on the new house.
emails.notes: Subject says renewal, but the new content is an address change: a test of reading the body over the subject. The quoted text below is the E04 renewal question and should not set the category. The condo policy (KB-CO-0098214) and the new home policy are follow-on work the broker spots.

emails.subject: New van - please add to policy
emails.requested_change: Add a 2025 Ram ProMaster 2500 service van to the commercial auto policy from 2026-11-09. Driver Owen Fraser. Send pink slips and the invoice to the bookkeeper.
emails.notes: Story step 4 pair, second email. After the E06 correction is fed back, the AI should give the company, not 'Tamsin Lee'. Owen Fraser is a second distractor, since the surname matches the company.
